body:
**Verification:** Production testing is done. Smoke tested the Link is Clicked in Saleshandy trigger (Zoho) on Production, all 5 activities:

| # | Activity | What was checked | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Create/Update a Contact in Zoho | Prospect not in Zoho: one contact created with the mapped Contact Fields and one note with Click Count 1. Second link clicked: Click Count reaches 2, still one contact, and a second note. Existing contact with an old Title: the same contact is updated and no second contact is made. | Pass |
| 2 | Create/Update a Lead in Zoho | Prospect not in Zoho: one lead created with the mapped Lead Fields and the prospect company, and one note. | Pass |
| 3 | Create/Update Account in Zoho | Prospect with a company and no contact: account created with the company name and the mapped Account Fields, not linked to a contact. | Pass |
| 4 | Create/Update a Deal in Zoho | Prospect not in Zoho, Closing date 0: one deal created with the Deal Value as Amount, Stage Qualification and an empty Closing Date, and no contact is created. Contact with 2 deals: only the newest deal is updated and the older deal is unchanged. | Pass |
| 5 | Create a Task in Zoho | Contact created, then one task linked to it with the configured Subject, Status, Priority and the due date set 3 days ahead. | Pass |
waitingFor: QA to review wording and send via npm run jira.
